definitions.explanation: Regular attention to keep something in good condition.
A police raid or inspection, especially of illegal establishments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手入|てい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}らない→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧。
⟦{革靴|かわぐつ}→革靴：15433_kawagutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手入|てい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{長持|ながも}ち→長持ち：14474_nagamochi⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Leather shoes won't last long if you don't take care of them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手入|てい}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{摘発|てきはつ}→摘発：12935_tekihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The shop was raided by the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧な⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手入|てい}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A raid was conducted on the shop that had been operating illegally.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧{手入|てい}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧にいた⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧{事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: A raid came suddenly in the middle of the night, and all the customers inside the shop were questioned.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in)

Literally 'putting in hands' → giving attention to.
- {手入|てい}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to maintain, to care for
- {手入|てい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ - to perform maintenance (formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手入|てい}れ - garden maintenance
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧/⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手入|てい}れ - skincare/haircare
- ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手入|てい}れ - tool maintenance
- {手入|てい}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|い}き{届|とど}いている→行き届く：30420_ikitodoku⟧ - well-maintained
- ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手入|てい}れ - police raid

SECOND MEANING:
The sense of 'raid' comes from the idea of police 'putting their hands into' an establishment.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- メンテナンス - maintenance (loanword)
- ⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧ - maintenance (machines, systems)
- ⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧ - care, looking after
